name: Multi-Frame Rate Volume Rendering
definition: An asynchronous approach to parallel volume rendering where workload is distributed over multiple GPUs. A fast display GPU provides high frame rates and low latency for user input, while one or more backend GPUs asynchronously provide new high-quality views.
summary: Multi-frame rate volume rendering uses asynchronous multi-GPU processing and layered image warping to balance high frame rates with high visual quality and motion parallax.
